about.description: Cotton's Restaurant is located on Pleasure Island in Orange Beach, Alabama. We have been serving families, friends and guests since 1985, featuring lobster, oysters, steaks, and the best seafood the area has to offer.

menu.name: Potato Skins
menu.description: Fried Potato Jackets topped with melted Cheddar Cheese, Chives & Bacon Bits. Sour Cream served on the side.

menu.name: Tuna Nachos
menu.description: House made fried Won Tons with seared Ahi Tuna, Seaweed Salad & topped with Spicy Mayo & Eel Sauce.

menu.name: Gulf Shrimp Steamed
menu.description: 8-10 per order. Served hot or cold.

menu.name: Cotton's Crab Queso
menu.description: Melted Pepper Jack Cheese infused with Onions & Crab Meat. Served with toasted Pita Points.

menu.name: Cotton's Crab Cakes
menu.description: Deep fried or blackened, topped with lump Crabmeat & our Remoulade Sauce.

menu.name: Cove Spicy Shrimp
menu.description: Fried Bay Shrimp tossed in a mild Chili Sauce.

menu.name: Fried Green Tomatoes
menu.description: Fresh local grown Tomatoes breaded & fried. Topped with our house made Tomato Relish, Feta Cheese & Remoulade Sauce.

menu.name: Crab Claws
menu.description: Fresh from the Gulf of Mexico. Fried or Sautéed.

menu.name: 'Shrooms
menu.description: Local favorite for over 35 years. Fresh Mushroom Caps filled with our signature Herb Cheese & deep fried to perfection.

menu.name: Cove Burger
menu.description: Hand pattied Angus Ground Beef, seasoned & cooked over flame roasted chargrill, toasted Bun with Lettuce, Tomato, sliced Onion & hamburger Dill Pickles. Cooked to order. One side.

menu.name: House Salad
menu.description: Fresh tossed Greens with seasonal Vegetables, Cheddar Cheese, Bacon Bits & your choice of dressing.

menu.name: Stuffed Avocado
menu.description: Avocado Seasoned and Chargrilled. Stuffed with Blackened Chicken or Shrimp, Black Bean Pico, Mozzarella and Cheddar Cheese. Topped with a Creamy Tequila Lime Avocado Sauce.

menu.name: Fish Tacos
menu.description: Three lightly seasoned grilled Fish Tacos, Corn Tortilla, spicy Mayo and Slaw. One side.

menu.name: Shrimp or Chicken Salad
menu.description: Fresh tossed Greens with seasonal Vegetables, Cheddar Cheese, Bacon bits & your choice of dressing. Fried, grilled or blackened.

specials.name: Early Bird Special
specials.description: Perfectly prepared, choice hand-cut Filet Mignon with smashed fried potatoes, ONLY $19.95!
